delivery_constraints: No narration/voice-over, no captions or text cards, no intro/outro/teaser. Every hook is carried by picture, diegetic sound and existing screenplay dialogue only. Types limited to cold_open / flashforward (narration and text_card are switched off for this project).

opening_hooks.angle: spectacle — the iconic impossible image first
opening_hooks.copy: A girl in a blue dress and pinafore drifts slowly downward through a dark well lined with cupboards and bookshelves, hair floating up — then a hard cut to the silent, sunlit Thames bank.
opening_hooks.visual: S03 (SCN-falling-dream): the slow-fall wide, Alice drifting past glazed cupboards and a bookshelf, skirts billowing, face calm and curious (the shot before she takes the ORANGE MARMALADE jar). Hard cut on the hollow hush + clock tick into S01's bees and lapping water.
opening_hooks.sound: S03 hollow hush and the tick of an unseen clock, cut dead into S01 bees/backwater — the clock tick pre-echoes the church clock striking two.
opening_hooks.extra_cost: none — a 3 s trim of the S03 fall shot already required by the episode; edit reuses it at the head. Adds ~3 s to the episode (550 → 553 s, inside the 540 s ±10% budget).
opening_hooks.screenplay_change_proposal: Add at head of S01: 'FLASH-FORWARD (3 s, no sound but the hush and a clock tick): Alice falling slowly through the well of cupboards (from S03). HARD CUT TO S01.' No dialogue change. Proposal only — screenplay.md not edited.
opening_hooks.fidelity_note: Keeps the dream frame honest (SUP-001): the viewer is promised the fall, then shown the drowsy real bank it grows from; the fall stays a photographed rigged slow fall (SUP-008) through the dream well, per the dream-environment reading of BIB-0027 (WR-010).

opening_hooks.angle: character & wit — Carroll's own first line, heard
opening_hooks.copy: “What is the use of a book without pictures or conversations?”
opening_hooks.visual: S01 (SCN-riverbank): open tight on the sister's open book — close grey print margin to margin, no pictures — Alice's face slides into frame over her sister's arm as she says the line; the wide establishing of the Thames bank follows instead of preceding it.
opening_hooks.dialogue: LN-ep01-001 (CHAR-alice, 4.8 s) — the first 3 s land on 'What is the use of a book without pictures…', the line completes over the reveal.
opening_hooks.sound: Bees and backwater under the line; the sister's page turn answers it before 'Hush, Alice dear.'
opening_hooks.extra_cost: none — reorders S01's first shots (book-page insert first, establishing wide second); no new set, no added length.
opening_hooks.screenplay_change_proposal: S01: move the book-page close-up and LN-ep01-001 ahead of the establishing wide of the bank; the wide becomes the answer shot after 'Hush, Alice dear.' Proposal only.
opening_hooks.fidelity_note: Most faithful to the book's famous opening and to the gentle period tone; weakest on raw 3-second retention for a cold YouTube audience because nothing impossible has happened yet.

opening_hooks.angle: identity mystery — the episode's big question up front
opening_hooks.copy: A giant girl hunched under a stone vault, a doll-sized fan in her hand, asks the dark: “…who in the world am I?”
opening_hooks.visual: S08 (SCN-long-hall): nine-foot Alice sitting hunched under the vault, knees to chin, tiny white kid glove and fan in her enormous hand, lamplight on the tear water round her; she stops fanning on the question. Hard cut to the still Thames bank.
opening_hooks.dialogue: Tail of LN-ep01-022 (CHAR-alice): 'But if I'm not the same, who in the world am I?' — the edit takes only 'who in the world am I?' (~2 s) from the same take; no new line.
opening_hooks.sound: Lamp hiss and dripping water under the line; hard cut to summer bees.
opening_hooks.extra_cost: none in generation — a trim of the S08 giant-Alice shot; the S08 generation group should keep 'who in the world am I?' as a clean line-end in one shot so it can be lifted without a mid-word cut (note to pacing/edit). Adds ~3 s.
opening_hooks.screenplay_change_proposal: Add at head of S01: 'FLASH-FORWARD (3 s): giant Alice under the vault, fan in hand — “…who in the world am I?” HARD CUT TO S01.' Proposal only.
opening_hooks.fidelity_note: Plants fs-030 (identity question) as the series thesis; gives away the growth effect and the climax image early, so it spends more of the episode's surprise than oh-1.

ending_cliffhangers.copy: Chin-deep in her own tears, Alice hears something splashing in the dark — she freezes, ripples come toward her, cut to black.
ending_cliffhangers.visual: S10 (SCN-pool-of-tears): close on tiny Alice treading water, lamplight on her face; ripples roll into frame from off-screen dark; hold on her still, wide eyes; CUT TO BLACK.
ending_cliffhangers.dialogue: Ends on LN-ep01-031 'However, everything is queer to-day.' before the splash.
ending_cliffhangers.sound: Off-screen splashing, then silence on the black.
ending_cliffhangers.extra_cost: none — exactly the current screenplay ending.

ending_cliffhangers.angle: partial glimpse — a wake coming at her
ending_cliffhangers.copy: Out of the lamplit dark a V-shaped wake cuts steadily toward Alice; she draws breath — black, and one last splash in the dark.
ending_cliffhangers.visual: S10 (SCN-pool-of-tears): after Alice's reverse (she turns to the sound), a low water-level shot from her tiny height: a single V-wake crossing the lamplight on the tear water toward camera, its maker hidden under the surface glare/shadow; cut to black as the wake reaches the frame edge; one splash over black.
ending_cliffhangers.sound: Splashing grows closer, cut; a single splash on black.
ending_cliffhangers.spoiler_note: Shows that something swims toward her, never what; the photoreal CGI Mouse (BIB-0027, SUP-002) is not on screen and no CGI creature asset is needed — the wake is practical water on the pool set (SUP-007).
ending_cliffhangers.extra_cost: one extra shot (~2 s) on the S10 pool set with a practical wake; no new character, prop or scene.
ending_cliffhangers.screenplay_change_proposal: S10, after 'Alice stops swimming and turns towards the sound': add '动作: From her water-level eye-line, a small V-shaped wake crosses the lamplight toward her; whatever makes it stays under the dark. CUT TO BLACK on the wake. 声音: one splash over black.' Proposal only.

ending_cliffhangers.angle: scale reveal — she is not alone
ending_cliffhangers.copy: The camera rises off tiny Alice to the flooded hall: in the dark beyond the lamps, ring after ring of ripples — more than one thing is swimming here.
ending_cliffhangers.visual: S10 (SCN-pool-of-tears): crane/high wide from above Alice, the hall as a flooded canyon (door bases as cliffs, table legs as columns, the Rabbit's fan drifting); in the shadows beyond the lamps several separate ripple rings spread and cross; hold, cut to black.
ending_cliffhangers.sound: Several splashes from different directions, layered; silence on black.
ending_cliffhangers.spoiler_note: Hints that the pool is crowded (ep02 opening beat) but reveals no creature and not the Mouse; does not touch ep02's climax (the Mouse's tale and exit).
ending_cliffhangers.extra_cost: one high wide (~3 s) of the pool set with multiple practical ripple sources; the rising camera move needs a whitebox camera path in the S10 group.
ending_cliffhangers.screenplay_change_proposal: S10 last action: replace the close hold with a rising high wide showing multiple ripple rings spreading in the dark beyond the lamps; then CUT TO BLACK. Proposal only.

recommendation.opening_reason: Strongest 3-second image for a cold YouTube viewer (a real girl slowly falling through a house turned on end), costs nothing new, and it spends the least of the episode's later surprises; the church-clock/tick rhyme ties it into S01.
recommendation.ending_reason: A visible, approaching wake converts the written sound-only ending into a picture a viewer can't leave, while keeping the swimmer's identity (ep02's opening reveal) fully hidden; one cheap practical insert on an existing set.
recommendation.fallback: If no screenplay change is wanted at all: oh-2 (reorder only) + ec-1 (as written).
